Title: Login button does not respond on mobile Safari
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the app on iOS Safari.
2. Enter valid credentials.
3. Tap the Login button.
Actual Result: Nothing happens — no spinner, no navigation, no error toast.
Expected Result: User is logged in and routed to the dashboard.

Title: Add password-strength meter to signup
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the signup form.
2. Type a weak password.
Expected Result: A meter under the password field reflects strength as the user types.

Title: Order list intermittently shows duplicates
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Navigate to Orders.
2. Refresh several times.
Actual Result: Some orders appear twice in the list.
Expected Result: Each order should appear exactly once.
